exposure: Clinical phenotypes of pathological fetal heart rate (FHR) tracings
cohort: The study included 271 women beyond 32 weeks of gestation who were in labour with pathological fetal heart rate tracing during delivery.
finding: While the 5-min Apgar score was comparable across all clinical phenotypes of pathological FHR tracing, tachycardia with reduced variability was associated with a significantly higher likelihood of NICU admission.
mod_finding: Most women (64%) included in the study underwent cesarean delivery.
